messages:
deploybot: Scheduled rollout (canary) for dedicated/vanguard-tenant slice: model-runner v2.3.1 + db-migration v2026-03-20 at 03:00 UTC. Initiator: Priya S. Runbook: https://intra.redwood/runbooks/vanguard-db-mig. React with :thumbsup: to approve.
Priya S: quick note — this is a small schema add (nullable index on user_events). No expected downtime; will run as background migrate. Canary will route 1% traffic for 15m.
Alex K: do we need to pin model version for this tenant during migration? want to avoid model reloads triggering cache misses.
Mateo R: yes — recommend pin to v2.3.1 for the entire window. fallback policy -> v2.2.9 if latency > 500ms or error rate > 1%.
Jordan: KMS key rotation check done? customer requested HSM key usage for private deployment.
Lin H: KMS/HSM verified in staging. Logging/audit to tenant-audit-bucket enabled. Also adding a quick command to toggle traffic if we need to abort:
```
# shift traffic back to stable
redwood traffic shift --tenant vanguard --from slice-canary --to slice-stable --percent 0
```
Sam T: What are the rollback SLO thresholds? ops runbook link? need to prep Customer Success for comms.
Priya S: Rollback thresholds: latency p95 > 450ms for 5m OR 5xx rate > 0.8% for 10m => auto-shift. Runbook: https://intra.redwood/runbooks/vanguard-db-mig#rollback. Release notes uploaded to the ticket (TICKET-4821).
Alex K: :thumbsup: I'm good. tagging @customer-success to prep message.
deploybot: Canary started at 03:02 UTC. 1% traffic to canary slice. Monitoring: telemetry/rdw-vanguard-canary. I'll post updates at 03:17 UTC or on status change.
Jordan: Noted — KMS audit log slice created. cc @security.
